meta.intervention: Each affected customer has a category-specific probability of a one-point score increase; business effort per improvement step is held equal.
meta.information_sets: One-step focus rules use only observed score summaries and do not receive generated hidden success chances. Multi-step sensitivity plans receive the exact generated category-specific chances and therefore represent perfect-information upper bounds.

response_regime_assumptions.equal_response: Every category is equally easy to move.
response_regime_assumptions.hidden_response: Ease of movement is drawn independently and randomly for every category.
response_regime_assumptions.tight_easier: Lower-SD categories are easier and higher-SD categories are harder to move.
response_regime_assumptions.loose_easier: Higher-SD categories are easier and lower-SD categories are harder to move.

strategy_definitions.edge_count: Select the category with the largest observed count of scores 6 and 8 combined.
strategy_definitions.edge_mean_volume_narrow: Select a large category whose observed average is close to score 6 or 8; category size is weighted by a narrow closeness bandwidth of 0.35 score points.
strategy_definitions.edge_mean_volume: Select a large category whose observed average is close to score 6 or 8; category size is weighted by a middle closeness bandwidth of 0.65 score points.
strategy_definitions.edge_mean_volume_wide: Select a large category whose observed average is close to score 6 or 8; category size is weighted by a wide closeness bandwidth of 1.00 score point.
strategy_definitions.category_volume: Select the category linked to the largest total number of responses across scores 0 to 10.
strategy_definitions.tight_edge: Select an edge-near category while favoring lower observed standard deviation.
strategy_definitions.loose_edge: Select an edge-near category while favoring higher observed standard deviation.
strategy_definitions.lowest_sd: Select the category with the lowest observed score standard deviation, regardless of its average.
strategy_definitions.highest_sd: Select the category with the highest observed score standard deviation, regardless of its average.

effort_capacity_experiment.assumption: One improvement step creates at most one score-point increase for each responsive customer; totals from one to six steps are tested and business effort per step is equal.
effort_capacity_experiment.planner_information: For the three category-specific sensitivity regimes, the optimizer receives each exact generated category success probability without estimation error. These are perfect-information upper bounds. The equal-response regime is a neutral baseline when category-specific probabilities are unknown, not evidence that real probabilities are equal.

exact_checks.equal_cost_equal_response_rule: For one-point moves with equal business effort per step and equal response probability, expected immediate NPS gain is maximized exactly by the largest count of scores 6 and 8 combined.
exact_checks.category_gain_per_cost_formula: (100 / total respondents) * response probability * (count at 6 + count at 8) / business effort per improvement step
